title: The Lover Gone Missing in a Snowstorm
notes: Recurring detective-cast (Conan, Ai Haibara as background presence) omitted by convention; Genta and Ayumi are kept as full person nodes because their individual actions (Genta secretly eating ice cream from the freezer, Ayumi noticing the garlic smell at dinner) are the two facts the whole solution hinges on. No `event` node type: every action is a directly typed edge between the entities involved. The old cases/ file's culprit (Juri Himuro) matches the transcript -- this is not a wrong-culprit case -- but its structure undersold the mystery: it filed Aya as a plain 'suspect' when the transcript makes her an exonerated eyewitness (seen returning from the side road empty-handed, which is exactly what clears her), used a single generic 'Ice Room lakeside' location for three narratively distinct places (the villa, its kitchen/freezer, and the side-road cliff where the trap was actually set), used only generic 'knows' edges for what are really a manipulated-boyfriend plot (Masahiko was already breaking up with Juri for another woman) and a false confession by Ryoko to shield Juri, and listed the medicine only as a vague 'hidden medication' rather than the staged pretext Juri used to get Masahiko to volunteer for the fatal errand. case_type: murder.

clues.desc: Garlic-smelling ice-cream crumbs and a wrapper were frozen inside the trap ice, but no dinner dish had garlic -- the smell traces to Genta's secret snack from the same kitchen freezer where the trap plate was made, fixing when and where it was frozen.

Aya was seen returning from the side road empty-handed and off-guard, but setting the trap required carrying a cooler box and a shovel -- proving she only witnessed the scene rather than set the trap.
